<<MENDING OF FISHING NETS, BRIEFLY>>

THE MENDING OF FISHING NETS IS A HONEST AND NECESSARY PART OF FISHING LIFE. IT IS DONE BY LOCAL FISHERS WHO USE THEIR HANDS AND FEET TO REPAIR THE NETS. THEY USE [WOOD TYPE] TO MAKE THE MENDINGS AND [NET SIZE] TO DETERMINE HOW MUCH NEED TO BE DONE. THE [MEETING TIME] IS WHEN THE FISHERS COME TOGETHER TO DISCUSS AND DO THE MENDING. THE [BOAT NAME] IS USED TO SHOW THE NETS ARE REPAIRING AND READY FOR USE.
